Alviso CNRA:
The area of Alviso in which the CDBG projects will occur is presently zoned R-3-B. This zone allows for two-story multi-family uses.
Campus CNRA:
The commercial streets of Santa Clara and 4th Street are zoned C-1. The remainder of this neighborhood is zoned R-4, which allows for multi-family uses, up to and including 6 stories.
Gardner CNRA:
The R-1 and R-2 zoning classifications predominate in Gardner, with R-2 present from Fuller Avenue north to Route 280. Zone C-1 exists along the Willow Street border and at some major intersections in the otherwise residential neighborhood.
Mayfair CNRA:
With the exception of the Alum Rock Avenue frontage, which lies within a C-3 zoning district (retail business and services) the Mayfair neighborhood is exclusively residential. Multi-family zoning of R-2 is located east of Sunset and south of Kammerer Avenues and in some isolated pockets elsewhere in the area. The dominant zone classification is R-1; B-6, single-family residential use on a 6,000 square foot lots.
Northside CNRA:
The large Northside neighborhood is primarily zoned R-2, with small pockets of C-1 zoning at intersections of the major east/west and north/wouth street. A large block of C zoning occurs at Taylor Street and the Bayshore Freeway. Industrial zoning classifications of M-1 and M-4 are located in the north-westerly corner with another area of M-1 zoning along 13th Street between Taylor and Jackson Streets.
Olinder CNRA:
The light industrial classification of M-1 is used along 24th Street and in the southeasterly corner of Olinder, from Brookwood to William Street, easterly of 22nd Street. The C-1 zone is applied along the strip commercial of Santa Clara Street. Between this zone and San Fernando Street is R-3, multi-family, three-story and from San Fernando to William Street the zoning is R-2, multi-family, two-story.
